purpose: Unknown-name reception wins over bad Throwable type before API entry; named/positional packets distinguish count from duplicate errors, stop later producers, and preserve fresh-body recovery through named throw and empty packs.
source:
<?php
function stream109P() {
    global $body, $stop;
    $body = $body + 1; echo 'INIT|';
    try { $received = yield 'head'; echo 'BAD-SEND|'; }
    catch (Throwable $caught) { echo 'CAUGHT|', $caught === $stop, '|'; yield 'caught'; }
    return 109;
}
function value109P($label, $value) { echo $label, '|'; return $value; }
function late109P() { echo 'BAD-LATE|'; return []; }
$body = 0; $answer = 97; $stop = new Exception('stop109P'); $generator = stream109P();
echo 'UNKNOWN|';
try { $answer = $generator->throw(exception: value109P('TYPE', 17), extra: value109P('NAME', 29)); }
catch (Throwable $caught) {
    $trace = $caught->getTrace();
    echo $caught instanceof Error, '|', $caught->getMessage() === 'Unknown named parameter $extra', '|', !isset($trace[0]), '|', $body === 0, '|', $answer === 97, '|';
}
echo 'COUNT|';
try { $answer = $generator->send(...['value' => 41], ...[42]); }
catch (Throwable $caught) {
    $trace = $caught->getTrace();
    echo $caught instanceof ArgumentCountError, '|', $caught->getMessage() === 'Generator::send() expects exactly 1 argument, 2 given', '|', $body === 0, '|', $answer === 97, '|';
    echo 'TRACE|', $trace[0]['function'] === 'send', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Generator', '|', $trace[0]['type'] === '->', '|', $trace[0]['args'][0] === 41, '|', $trace[0]['args'][1] === 42, '|', !isset($trace[1]), '|';
}
echo 'DUPLICATE|';
try { $answer = $generator->send(...[41], ...['value' => 42]); }
catch (Throwable $caught) {
    $trace = $caught->getTrace();
    echo $caught instanceof Error, '|', $caught->getMessage() === 'Named parameter $value overwrites previous argument', '|', !isset($trace[0]), '|', $body === 0, '|', $answer === 97, '|';
}
echo 'EARLY|';
try { $answer = $generator->current(...['extra' => 17], ...late109P()); }
catch (Throwable $caught) {
    $trace = $caught->getTrace();
    echo $caught instanceof Error, '|', $caught->getMessage() === 'Unknown named parameter $extra', '|', !isset($trace[0]), '|', $body === 0, '|', $answer === 97, '|';
}
echo 'START|', $generator->throw(...['exception' => $stop]) === 'caught', '|', $body === 1, '|';
$generator->next(...[]);
echo 'RETURN|', $generator->getReturn(...[]) === 109, '|';

purpose: The selected Generator receiver survives spread-producer CV retirement. A by-value alias snapshot stays distinct from caller writes; last API receiver release closes finally and retires the Token before caller return.

<?php
class Token109L { function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
function stream109L() {
    global $cell, $weakToken, $weakGenerator;
    try {
        echo 'INIT|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|';
        $received = yield 'head';
        $cell = 41;
        echo 'GOT|', $received === $weakToken->get(), '|', $cell === 41, '|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|';
        yield 'tail';
        echo 'BAD-RESUME|';
    } finally {
        echo 'FIN|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token109L, '|', $cell === 41, '|';
    }
}
function pack109L() {
    global $generator, $pack;
    echo 'PACK|'; $saved = $pack; $generator = null; $pack = null; return $saved;
}
$cell = new Token109L(); $weakToken = WeakReference::create($cell);
$pack = ['value' => &$cell];
$generator = stream109L(); $weakGenerator = WeakReference::create($generator);
echo 'CALL|'; $result = $generator->send(...pack109L());
echo 'RETURN|', $result === 'tail', '|', $generator === null, '|', $pack === null, '|', $weakGenerator->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|', $cell === 41, '|';
